accounting: binding is pure graph work; no oracle constructed, no network call

contract.note: pmo_joint_dependency_jump and pmo_population_controller are imported read-only; all chemistry in every arm is the pinned implementation. Partial/prefix binding was deliberately NOT implemented: an executable fragment that does not meet the plan's own completion conditions is a different, unspecified transformation, not a smaller version of it.

inferred.basis: Composes the measured attribution (neighbor_element_histogram alone accounts for a 2.55x swing in depth-0 feasibility) with the measured referee result (exhaustive search does not rescue the remainder). Not itself an ablation of a replacement design.
inferred.claim: The binding bottleneck is OVER-SPECIFICATION in the plan representation, not search. A v1 plan is a chain of ~28-31 exact whole-neighbourhood fingerprints; realizing it demands the parent reproduce the teacher's local chemistry at every step in the teacher's order. That is a strictly stronger demand than 'perform this transformation here', which is what a region-and-interface specification would express.

inferred.basis: Definitional, from the role-identity contract in pmo_action_roles.py.
inferred.claim: Relaxing the descriptor is NOT the repair. A match under a coarsened view realizes a DIFFERENT transformation from the one the plan specifies, so the attribution views measure where the constraint bites; they do not define a legal weaker binding.

measured.claim: 66.9% of all (plan, parent) pairs are PROVEN unbindable before any search. Role 0 requires operand descriptors no active atom of the parent carries, so no beam width, no ranking and no budget can bind them. This caps the achievable binding rate at 33.1% for the v1 plan bank on these parents.

Among step-0-feasible production_init pairs the exhaustive referee -- the beam removed entirely -- still proves NO_COMPATIBLE_BINDING for 27 of 30. Every beam width from 4 to 64 returns a binding rate of 0.000 on that stratum. Beam width is therefore not the production bottleneck.

DISCARDED_BY_SEARCH (outcome b) is real but marginal: 2 of 80 pairs, both teacher_witness at 31 primitives with referee peak frontier 23 against a beam of 4. Widening to 8-64 did NOT recover them -- the wider arms exhausted their wall budget first -- so even where truncation demonstrably discards a valid binding, widening the beam is not what recovers it.

Compatibility ranking is the ONLY intervention that moves the binding rate: at width 4 it yields 31 complete programs against hash's 17 (+82%), and binds 2 production_init pairs where hash binds 0. It is NOT A FIX. The extra programs have the same median scale (16.0), the same maximum (23) and the same retained fraction (1.000) as hash's; zero of them reach teacher scale and zero fall in the teacher retained band.

NO arm, at any width, under either ranking, produced a single complete program at teacher scale (>=27 primitives) or inside the teacher retained-fraction band (0.52-0.96). Every realized program has retained_fraction 1.000 -- purely additive, removing nothing -- against teachers at 0.52-0.96. Teacher-scale programs did not become reachable under any intervention tested.

Wider beams produce FEWER complete programs (17 at w4, 12 at w8, 6 at w16/32/64), because the added breadth is spent on wall time the arm does not have. Under a fixed wall budget, widening the beam is strictly negative on this corpus.

The depth-0 refusal is attributable to ONE field of the v1 role encoding. Dropping neighbor_element_histogram lifts step-0 feasibility from 33.1% to 84.4% (2.55x); dropping implicit_hydrogens or bond_class_histogram changes nothing at all. The role pins each operand's complete elemental neighbourhood -- a whole-environment fingerprint, not a region-and-interface specification.

63 of 95 plans additionally pin the TEACHER's step ordering through created_ordinal and creation_lag on created-handle operands (lag median 1, max 21), so a chemically identical transformation performed in a different order cannot match.

evidence.definition: created-handle operands carry created_ordinal and creation_lag, which pin the TEACHER's step ordering into the role identity: a chemically identical transformation performed in another order cannot match.

measured.claim: The instrumented binder reproduces the pinned bind_joint_plan exactly: 12 of 12 equivalence checks identical at widths 4 and 8, including a non-empty case (1 vs 1 at w4, 5 vs 5 at w8). The referee's necessary-condition prefilter changes cost but never an outcome: 13 agree, 0 disagree, 5 undecided against the unfiltered reference run.

not_established: Whether a region-and-interface representation with explicit created-handle dependencies and constraint propagation actually raises complete-program yield. Nothing here tests a replacement design; this work bounds the defect and rules out search-side repairs.
The teacher-witness stratum is mostly undetermined: 14 of 20 referee calls and 13-18 of 20 bounded arms hit their wall budget, so the binding rate there is a lower bound, not an estimate.
Wall-clock seconds for the first ~3 minutes of the sweep are contended (orphaned workers from a killed run). successors_enumerated is the load-independent cost metric and is the one to cite.

primary_metric.definition: P(legal executable COMPLETE realization | abstract plan, parent), composed as P(step-0 feasible) x P(bind | step-0 feasible), the first measured exhaustively over all 2,185 pairs and the second on the stratified sample

provenance.concurrency_note: A concurrent session modified PMO-v1 LAUNCH artifacts during this run (configs/pmo_population_controller_v1*.json, modal_apps/pmo_population_v1_app.py, tools/reseal_pmo_population_contracts.py and others, 18:54-19:08). None of the modules this measurement imports were touched -- all five verified byte-identical to HEAD, with mtimes predating this session -- so the binding law measured here is the pinned one.

stage_1_static_census.definition: role 0 requires operand descriptors that no active atom of the parent carries; a proof of no_compatible_binding at depth 0, independent of beam width, ranking and search budget

stage_2_witness_control.note: plans bound back onto the teacher source that generated them; a complete role-consistent realization provably exists, so any bounded-arm failure here is DISCARDED_BY_SEARCH by construction

stage_4_yield.definition: every COMPLETE program produced by any arm, against the teacher profile; partial/prefix bindings are not reported as realizations

stage_5_specification_attribution.definition: step-0 operand availability when operand descriptors are compared on a projected field set.  DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: a match under a coarser view realizes a DIFFERENT transformation than the plan specifies, so this is not a proposal to loosen matching.  It attributes the depth-0 refusal to specific over-specified fields of the v1 role encoding.

stage_6_plan_specification.definition: created-handle operands carry created_ordinal and creation_lag, which pin the TEACHER's step ordering into the role identity: a chemically identical transformation performed in another order cannot match.
